Try itThe error of a turn

The error is the angle left to turn, the short way. A positive error means turn left (counterclockwise), a negative one, turn right. Headings are in radians, from \(-\pi\) to \(\pi\).

The shorter way: add or remove \(2\pi\)Target minus heading is between \(-2\pi\) and \(2\pi\). Past half a turn (\(\pi\)), the other way is shorter: add or remove one full turn. In pseudo code:
d = target - heading          # between -2*pi and 2*pi
if d > pi:     d = d - 2*pi   # turn right instead
elif d <= -pi: d = d + 2*pi   # turn left instead
error = d                     # between -pi and pi

target °
